newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Aristocrat appoints John Dougall ceo.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Aristocrat appoints John Dougall ceo.

text.p: Gambling machine operator Aristocrat Industries Ltd said on Wednesday that former AWA Ltd managing director John Dougall had been appointed executive chairman and chief executive officer.
Dougall replaces Allan McDonald as chairman and Gary Garton as managing director,
Aristocrat said that McDonald and Garton had resigned from the board, although Garton would continue to serve as a consultant to the company.
It said Stephen Cohn had been promoted to director of finance.

Aristocrat, which listed on the Australian Stock Exchange in July, said that as previously announced, two independent non-executive directors would be appointed and an independent non-executive chairman would be sought as a priority.

Dougall's sudden departure from Sydney-based AWA was announced in early September at the same time as the company announced a A$14.26 million loss in 1995/96 and its continued restructuring to focus on communications and gaming operations.
He was replaced at AWA by John Rouse, who had been group general manager.
